n: 300 Series Electric Front Load Dryer - 8.0 Cu. Ft.
desc: This Electrolux 8 cu. ft. White Front-load electric dryer comes with 20 minutes fast drying feature that allows quick drying of the items that are much needed. The dryer makes sure that the clothes remain at their best by avoiding over-drying keeping the environment in mind.
hl: Extended Tumble option keeps clothes tangle-free
Gently tumbles your clothes without heat to keep them tangle-free--perfect for when you cannot remove clothes right after the cycle ends.
Normal Cycle Designed for Energy Efficiency
Our normal cycle was specifically created to use the least energy possible to get a full load dry, so normal use puts less burden on the planet.
Quickly dry the items you need most.
Keeps clothes looking their best without over drying
Clothes are gently tumbled while moisture sensors detect when clothes are dry to prevent over-drying.
Dry more in each load with our 8.0 Cu. Ft. dryers.
Fits more rooms with reversible door
Enjoy easy loading no matter how your washer and dryer are configured.
